newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee firms vs dlr, fresh inflows seen.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee firms vs dlr, fresh inflows seen.

text.p: The Nepali rupees opened at 56.92-56.94 rupees per dollar on Friday, firming a previous close of 56.96 rupees, dealers said.
There was no trading on Thursday, they said.
"The supply of dollar is good enough to cope up with existing demand, while the rupee may firm up further to 56.90 rupees per dollar on expected inflows," dealers said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.

Inter-bank call money rates opened at 6.00-6.50 percent on Friday, steady compared to previous close of 6.00 percent, dealers said. "As the last day of the weekend the call rate remained on the lower side" they said.
